propositions: The deprecated env var REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be removed from the resolver and all live documentation after operator-approved early removal pre-1.0 pass #3 (2026-08-12).
The config key [tool.rebar.llm].model remains live as it is load-bearing and widely read; only the env channel is removed.
A still-set REBAR_LLM_MODEL must fail loud with RemovedInputError in LLMConfig.from_env rather than being silently ignored, to prevent silent cost/quality changes.
The model resolution order post-removal is CLI > [tool.rebar.llm].model config table > built-in default, with no env channel.
All 15+ test files and operator docs (runbooks, compose file) that reference REBAR_LLM_MODEL must be retargeted to surviving config channels or reworded from deprecated to removed.
A tombstone registry entry must be added mirroring REBAR_LLM_MAX_ITERS precedent with behavior='error' and migration guidance to [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes] slots.
